d.ko: Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game. Colonize alien worlds, design your own spaceships, research exotic technologies, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy or open war. Build a galactic empire and rule it your way.
d.en: Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game. Colonize alien worlds, design your own spaceships, research exotic technologies, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy or open war. Build a galactic empire and rule it your way.
d.zh: 在这款单人太空 4X 策略游戏中，从一颗星球起步，建立银河帝国。探索 3D 银河，逐格建设殖民地，自主设计舰船，并通过外交或战争智胜其他种族。
